verdict.rationale: Inngest documents keyed concurrency, which applies limits per unique key value such as a user ID. That gives per-tenant isolation, so one tenant cannot monopolize execution, and it is backed by broader flow-control and throttling claims. The pack never documents assigning priorities to runs or a fair-queuing scheduler explicitly. Missing for 10: run priority assignment, explicit fair scheduling across tenants versus FIFO, detailed docs on scheduling semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I assign priorities to runs and get fair scheduling across tenants instead of a single FIFO queue

citations.quote: Step concurrency can be optionally configured using "keys" which applies the limit to each unique value of the key (ex. user id).
